data.name: MINOS INITIATIVE - 2112
data.detailed_description:
MINOS INITIATIVE – 2112

A dark sci-fi survival CRPG set deep beneath the surface of a dying world — inside a vast, fractured underground network known only as MINOS.

What began as a joint excavation and research project funded by powerful surface organizations has become something else entirely.
Something no faction fully controls anymore.

DESCEND INTO THE MINOS NETWORK

  • Procedurally generated sectors with dynamic layouts

  • Faction-influenced NPC's and abandoned infrastructure

  • Power systems, blackout zones, and reactive lighting

  • Hidden vaults, terminals, and encrypted data caches

  • Increasing instability the deeper you go

SURFACE FACTIONS & CONTRACTS

The remnants of the old world now operate from above, each with their own agenda:

  • HELIX EXTRACTIVE — resource dominance at any cost

  • BLACKLINE RECOVERY — retrieval of unknown assets

  • NADIR MATERIAL AUTHORITY — control through allocation and restriction

  • ZENITH INNOVATIONS — signal research and experimental technology

  • AURIC FRONTIER GROUP — wealth, rarity, and long-term control

Through Data Shards, you receive contracts from these factions:

  • Gather rare materials

  • Recover lost technology

  • Extract data from unstable systems

  • Deliver resources through hostile territory

SURVIVE THE UNDERGROUND

Everything you carry is something you fought to keep.

  • Scavenge scrap, batteries, med-gel, and rare materials

  • Manage inventory, weight, and scarcity

  • Craft and build tools, defenses, and utilities

  • Navigate darkness, failing systems, and environmental hazards

  • Find food, water, and moments of safety where you can

COMBAT & ENCOUNTERS

MINOS is not empty.

  • Engage rogue machines, corrupted systems, and unstable survivors

  • Fight faction remnants and operatives with their own objectives

  • Use tactical ranged and close-quarters combat

  • Adapt to unpredictable AI behavior and shifting threats

  • Survive encounters where control is an illusion

THE TRUTH IS FRAGMENTED

Through terminals, data shards, and scattered survivors, a pattern begins to form:

The factions above are not just observing MINOS.

They are competing over it.

And something deep below is responding.

DESCEND FURTHER

Every floor brings you closer to answers.

And further from safety.

Ensure you are prepared for anything at all costs.
